one_line_reason: Real single-ingredient human RCT evidence exists for TUDCA on endothelial function and insulin sensitivity in general/at-risk adults, alongside mixed results in ALS, liver-disease, and neonatal clinical trials.

selected.intervention: TUDCA 1500 mg, oral, single acute dose, single-blind randomized crossover vs placebo
selected.primary_outcome: brachial artery flow-mediated dilation (endothelial function) after an oral glucose challenge
selected.why_selected: Clean single-ingredient, dose-stated RCT in healthy volunteers showing TUDCA prevented the endothelial dysfunction normally caused by a glucose load

selected.intervention: TUDCA 1750 mg/day, oral, 4 weeks vs placebo
selected.primary_outcome: hepatic, muscle, and adipose-tissue insulin sensitivity (hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp)
selected.why_selected: Dose-stated RCT in a general obese (non-diagnosed-disease) population showing ~30% improvement in hepatic and muscle insulin sensitivity, though not adipose tissue

selected.population: 34 patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, already on riluzole
selected.intervention: TUDCA 1 g twice daily, oral, 54 weeks, add-on to riluzole vs placebo add-on
selected.primary_outcome: proportion of ALSFRS-R responders (≥15% improvement in disease-progression slope)
selected.why_selected: Proof-of-principle positive signal in a serious clinical disease population, illustrating the strongest disease-context evidence for TUDCA, though as an add-on therapy rather than standalone supplement use

selected.population: 22 neonates receiving total parenteral nutrition (TPN) after surgery, vs 30 untreated/placebo controls
selected.intervention: TUDCA 30 mg/kg/day, enteral, for TPN-associated cholestasis prevention
selected.primary_outcome: peak serum conjugated bilirubin, liver enzymes, and bile acids (liver injury markers)
selected.why_selected: A dose-stated pediatric clinical trial with a clearly negative result (TUDCA appeared ineffective), included to show the evidence is not uniformly positive across clinical populations

blockers: 25664595 and 12183720 are in serious clinical disease populations (ALS patients on riluzole; TPN-dependent neonates), not general wellness supplement use
Doses vary widely across trials (1500 mg single dose, 1750 mg/day, 2 g/day, 30 mg/kg/day), complicating a single label-dose mapping
25664595 tests TUDCA only as an add-on to riluzole, an approved ALS drug, not TUDCA alone

handoff_pmids.note: Double-blind RCT of TUDCA 2 g/day for 16 weeks in progressive multiple sclerosis; primary outcomes were explicitly safety and tolerability, with only exploratory clinical/microbiome outcomes

excluded_pmids.reason: This is the statistical analysis plan for the ongoing TUDCA-ALS phase III trial, published before results; no efficacy data available yet
Head-to-head TUDCA vs UDCA trial in primary biliary cholangitis patients; a clinical liver-disease population, and TUDCA showed comparable (not superior) efficacy to UDCA
Head-to-head TUDCA vs UDCA trial in liver cirrhosis patients (China); a clinical liver-disease population with a small sample (18 analyzed)
Both study arms received the same TUDCA 500 mg dose; the tested variable was acupoint catgut embedding as an add-on, not TUDCA itself
Animal (rat) model of TUDCA for acute cerebral infarction; not a human trial
Preclinical (cell line and rodent) systematic review of TUDCA/4-PBA for beta-cell secretory failure; not a human trial
Systematic review of bile acids (UDCA/GUDCA/TUDCA) in pre-clinical (animal/cell) models of brain disease; not a human trial
